DEV_AGENT.scope: Product/MVP runtime and domain implementation required by currently authorized execution tasks.
DEV_AGENT.deliverable: Production-grade implementation only; no stubs, TODO/FIXME, mocks, or parallel registry.

QA_AGENT.scope: Unit/integration/E2E and failure-mode vectors for the current MVP journey.
QA_AGENT.deliverable: Falsifiable test vectors and exact-SHA evidence requirements.

SEC_AGENT.scope: Threat model, input/output boundaries, dependency vulnerability posture, resource exhaustion and browser privacy boundaries.
SEC_AGENT.deliverable: Attack matrix and blockers with evidence.

OPS_AGENT.deliverable: Operational verification matrix and exact-SHA release conditions.

technical_debt_policy.decision: Do not delete candidates merely from name/pattern evidence; require dependency/reference proof. In particular, retain @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom and eslint until removal is proven non-breaking.
